description:
## Problem

src/vug/html_extractor.cr contains calculate_backoff_delay for exponential backoff with jitter. This is a generic utility pattern that could be shared across the codebase.

## What to do

1. Create src/vug/retry_helpers.cr with a module containing:
   - calculate_backoff_delay(attempt, base_delay, max_delay) : Time::Span
   - with_retry(max_retries, base_delay, max_delay, &block) for the retry loop pattern
2. Update HtmlExtractor to use the shared utility
3. Check if Fetcher or SingleRequest could also benefit from the shared pattern
4. Run specs to verify

## Why

- DRY: retry logic should not be reimplemented in each class
- Consistency: all retry behavior uses the same backoff strategy
- Testability: backoff logic can be tested in isolation
title: Extract retry backoff logic into shared utility
